case.title: Cotton Wool — octave-corrected reconstruction
case.method: Hardware FFT/STFT pitch families and attack estimates from the historical reconstruction, reinterpreted using the WIDE-off one-octave oscillator interval supported by Cotton Wool and Pedal Bs 1 recordings. The low peaks are the sine one octave below the Super Saw. All MIDI notes raised by 12 from the historical estimate; gates and velocity unchanged. No preset bytes modified.
uncertainties: This is an estimated reconstruction, not a recovered original MIDI performance.
Played MIDI octave is conditional on the measured WIDE-off range and default system transpose. The original performance MIDI has not been recovered.
Bass C2/C3 octave allocation is less certain than the Eb/F/Bb and Eb/F/A chord pitch classes because their harmonics overlap.
Onsets are approximate within roughly30–70 ms, with the later F3 strum less certain. Short-time analysis window smears exact attacks.
Note-off times are placeholders informed by audible-band decay; release envelopes and reverb prevent exact recovery.
Velocities, controllers, pitch bend, system transpose/tuning, master gain, and recording processing are unknown.
Small note overlaps, extra quiet notes, and the exact voicing may differ from this estimate.

All note-on velocities fixed to100 as an explicit placeholder. Original velocities were not recoverable, and filter velocity sensitivity is+18 in the published patch. No velocity or preset parameters were fitted against Septum output.
Five-second excerpt only; the later untranscribed performance is not compared with the rendered release tail.
